featured.name: AskDB
featured.description: A natural-language-to-SQL engine. Users provide a DDL schema and query their database in plain English. Built on a fine-tuned Llama 3 8B with QLoRA, trained on a unified pipeline of 134K examples drawn from 5 sources.
bullets: Unified 134K NL-to-SQL examples across 5 datasets into one training corpus.
Fine-tuned Llama 3 8B with QLoRA (4-bit NF4, LoRA rank 16) on a single GPU.
Flask inference API + Next.js frontend with schema upload and query history.
